projects.title: Fiery Revival
projects.description:
Ndezu is a gym focused on fitness and wellness. We led their rebranding efforts, creating a fresh brand identity and a strategic social media campaign to engage their audience and highlight their commitment to health and strength.

Awakening The Flame

Our founder envisioned a powerful rebrand for Ndezu, meaning "ignite" in English, to capture the essence of energy and transformation of his gym.

We crafted a bold identity that embodies the intensity of hard work in the gym—the burn, the drive, and the strength that comes with every rep.
